note: Butterfield Cayman's retail schedule (January 2026): chequing carries a monthly compliance fee of 2 dollars and a monthly maintenance fee of 6, waived when an average daily balance of 5,000 is kept. Per-item fees aren't modelled.

sources.title: Butterfield Bank (Cayman), Retail Schedule of Charges (January 2026)
